definition_quote.value: any person who has received a grant from and has been certified by the health benefit exchange established pursuant to section 1311 of the affordable care act, 42 U.S.C. § 18031, to act as a navigator, as such term is used in 42 U.S.C. § 18031(i), provided that the person: (A) has completed the training required by the health benefit exchange; (B) does not sell insurance; (C) does not engage in any activity with respect to insurance not expressly permitted under 42 U.S.C. § 18031(i)(3) and regulations thereunder; and (D) does not receive any compensation for acting as a navigator directly or indirectly from an insured, insurance producer, or an insurer.
